summary: Baseline 10460ef33c9b96a1b66756d5f5a6ee529e85f51b. Materialized and read the full primary RSS item KOONS-FOURTH-WAY-RECONSTRUCTION-2022-FULL-ITEM, all thirteen numbered steps and both closing paragraphs. Stable locators, rejected source readings and the plural/all-scope gaps remain in docs/notes/koons-fourth-way-reconstruction-2022-reading.md. This investigation tests the separately declared singular, pointwise other-directed modal profile, not the whole post or a covert substitution for strict nonmodal causal ascent. Reuse fixedEffects on Bool worlds and EffectBeing=Option Bool, its SoundDistinctCauses/necessary-source certificates and enumerateEffectBeing. alternatingEffects was inspected but its first effect is contingent, so it is not the intended two-necessary-individual tie control. Reuse OrderSecondary Fin 3 intensity labels, constructive preorder and enumeration. Intensity is independent of ExistsAt, neither a truth value nor a count of worlds; absent secondEffect intensity labels are ignored. Every model has actual reflexivity, a necessary actually present selected source and sound distinct concrete causation. TiedNecessary satisfies the entire nonlogical profile and gives two distinct necessary global maxima at the same intensity. It refutes uniqueness of a maximum among necessary individuals, not uniqueness of individuals satisfying the universal possible-causer role. VaryingDegree retains potential causation and the current-world weak bound while the selected source and effect vary together across worlds; bare and actual-guarded invariance fail, as does the named source maximum-at-every-world. It nevertheless has AttainedGlobalDegreeMaximum at true/source: this finite control does not refute the existence of some attained maximum or the unmodeled value/existence bridge. BelowEffect independently drops the weak bound, retaining potential causation and both invariance forms; the named source maximum fails. NoPotential independently drops potential universal causation, retaining the vacuous weak bound and both invariance forms; the named source maximum fails. PotentialOnly keeps the old fixedEffects frame/existence but gates its causal edge to world true. It satisfies both invariance forms and the full nonlogical profile, yet the source exercises no causation at the false standpoint. Worlds are alternatives, not times. The four original assignments and approved fifth assignment were frozen before proof bodies; the general theorem Challenge remained unchanged. Source-fidelity repair preserves the bare analyst invariant separately from ActualNecessaryDegreeInvariant, whose antecedent includes actual presence and necessity. All five guarded evaluations use the same frozen datasets and have the same truth mask as the bare condition: VaryingDegree violates, the other four satisfy. No absent-base degree comparison is attributed to source step 11. Focused model build passed. The existing finite-model gate accepted five registrations and 61 exact closed certificates with zero axioms; supplementary otherNecessaryMaximum, attainedMaximum and noActualExercise also have zero axioms. Finite decidability does not certify the separate general ExcludedMiddle premise. Independent source/type audit and final integrated corpus/build/binding/Comparator/NanoDa remain coordinator delivery gates; the finite checkpoint preceded canonical peer metadata integration. No old interpretation or registry was modified, no new source claim was authored here, and no root premise is discharged. General result references will be linked after their integration; the exact model registrations and Lean certificates are the current evidence. Follow-on discriminating residual: UnboundedWorlds uses universal Nat-labeled alternative worlds with fixedEffects presence and causal tables pulled back unchanged at false, and assigns intensity k to each individual at world label k. All worlds have the same two necessary present individuals and the same actual source-to-effect edge; the accessible family is identical from every world, so its changing intensity is not a count of worlds or chronology. The single fixed interpretation jointly satisfies universal access, actual reflexivity, actual and necessary source presence, sound distinct causation, pointwise other-directed possible causation and the current-world weak bound. Both invariance forms fail at 1 versus 0. It has no AttainedGlobalDegreeMaximum: for any candidate pair at v, the existing source at v+1 has strictly greater intensity. This strengthens the finite varying control, which still had an attained maximum. It shows that causal/weak-bound commitments without degree invariance do not even entail possible attainment in this precise degree profile; it does not assert a source value/existence bridge or refute an entire external argument. The infinite control is outside the finite-model registry. Its data and JointWitness proposition were frozen before the separate Challenge (SHA256 ef8cef070bfe32be225dd24ed19b74ff69cc43717eae394e1441cace3479d6a8), which remained unchanged during proof work. The model jointWitness and noAttainedMaximum are zero-axiom; the closed result MODAL-DEGREE-UNBOUNDED-WORLD-CONTROL wraps this exact target. Comparator/NanoDa and integrated binding remain queued with the coordinator rather than claimed from a local kernel build. A mechanical scope-reference issue was traced to a stale copied peer draft, not a missing canonical dependency. The owned argument and statement use canonical DISAMB-MODAL-CAUSE-POSSIBILITY-AND-EXERCISE, which already records single/plural, target and pointwise/joint witness scope; the orphan draft reference was removed. No new disambiguation, attribution machinery, shared metadata edit or tooling change is required. The copied draft remains outside the owned commit; integrated full corpus and result checks remain with the coordinator.
